shortDescription: Manage SSH proxy security profiles on a BIG-IP

options.name: default_action
options.description: Specifies the default action rule for the SSH proxy security profile. When creating a new policy, this parameter must be specified otherwise failure occurs.

options.name: description
options.description: Specifies descriptive text that identifies the SSH proxy profile.

options.name: lang_env_tolerance
options.description: Determines which connections with LANG environment variables set are allowed to pass through if the SSH Proxy profile has the C(other) channel type action set. When set to C(any), allows connections with any LANG environment value set. When set to C(none), disallows all connections with the LANG environment variable set. When set to C(common) allows only connections with the LANG environment value set to C(en_US.UTF-8) to pass through the C(other) restrictions. This setting is in effect only if

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the SSH proxy security profile to manage.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the SSH proxy security profile is created. When C(absent), ensures the SSH proxy security profile is removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies a timeout for the SSH proxy, in seconds.
